# The *Hypostasis of the Archons* — Sophia, Veil, Rulers, Adam, Norea, Eleleth, and the Root Above

`[[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/MYTHEME-WHOLE-STORY-AMPLIFICATION-LAW|Mytheme Whole-Story Amplification Law]]` **defines** the direction of this record. The primary unit is not “archon,” “firmament,” “Sophia,” “veil,” “demiurge,” “Norea,” “seven heavens,” or “Gnosticism” as a reusable symbolic label. It is the **whole relational cosmology and revolt/revelation sequence of Nag Hammadi Codex II,4, usually titled *The Hypostasis of the Archons* / *The Reality of the Rulers*.**

The record is intentionally source-first. Project interpretation remains separate because Native 020 had explicitly left the layered-cosmos / firmament / archons seam blocked until an intact source-bearing whole could be recovered.

---

## 1. Source identity and structure

The tractate is a Gnostic exposition of the **origin, nature and power of the rulers/authorities**. Its surviving Coptic text belongs to Nag Hammadi Codex II. Modern editions and translations differ in title and wording; Bentley Layton's *Hypostasis of the Archons* and Willis Barnstone / Marvin Meyer's *Reality of the Rulers* are current English carriers for this recovery.

Scholarly description of the tractate gives the essential cosmological distinction clearly: a **veil** divides an incorruptible, invisible realm above from the corruptible, visible realm of matter and ignorance below; the lower rulers arise inside the shadowed realm and reproduce a hierarchy modelled on what lies above them.

The whole narrative then moves through creation, human formation, domination, resistance and revelation rather than presenting one static map.

---

# 2. The whole relational sequence

## 2.1 The arrogant ruler mistakes a local realm for the entirety

The tractate begins from the rulers' claim to authority. Their chief is described as **blind**, powerful, ignorant and arrogant. He declares himself to be the sole god. A voice from incorruptibility answers that claim and names his error: he does not see the greater reality whose absence from his field he has mistaken for non-existence.

This is a source-side operation before any project amplification:

```text
local ruler sees only his own field
        ↓
field appears without visible superior inside itself
        ↓
absence from the field is read as absence from reality
        ↓
local power claims total authority
        ↓
voice from beyond the field contradicts the claim
```

The chief ruler is named **Samael** in this rebuke; the source tradition also gives the names **Yaldabaoth / Sakla** in the cosmological revelation.

## 2.2 Pistis Sophia · veil · shadow · matter · lower ruler

Later, through **Eleleth's revelation to Norea**, the tractate gives the rulers' genesis. **Pistis Sophia** desires to create without her consort. A veil lies between the world above and the lower realms. **Shadow** comes into being beneath the veil and becomes **matter**. A deficient/arrogant lion-like ruler emerges in that lower condition.

The ruler opens his eyes upon an apparently limitless quantity of matter and repeats the same totalising claim: because his horizon contains no visible prior reality, he treats his local horizon as the whole.

Sophia introduces light into matter, exposing the ruler's mistake without making the lower realm unreal.

The source whole therefore differentiates:

```text
incorruptible / invisible above
        ↓ boundary
veil
        ↓
shadow
        ↓
matter / lower realm
        ↓
local ruler arises within that realm
        ↓
local ruler mistakes his horizon for the entirety
        ↓
light from above reveals the error
```

## 2.3 The rulers and their layered heavens

The lower ruler generates **seven offspring**, rulers like their parent. The cosmology then distributes rule through layered heavens / chaotic realms. A secondary scholarly summary of the tractate describes Yaldabaoth's offspring as an organised hierarchy corresponding to the higher realm; surviving translations also place Sabaoth in the seventh heaven beneath the veil and describe the heavens of chaos becoming populated by subordinate powers.

This is the actual source-side basis of Native 020's **layered cosmos / firmament / archons** seam. The important relation is not simply “seven levels.” It is:

```text
higher order
        ↓ reflected / imitated through lower formation
lower ruler
        ↓
subordinate rulers / heavens
        ↓
administered cosmos
        ↓
local beings inhabit a world whose rulers claim more authority than their own genesis warrants
```

The hierarchy is therefore simultaneously cosmological and political within the story.

## 2.4 Zoe · Sabaoth · repentance inside the hierarchy

The lower hierarchy is not absolutely homogeneous. **Zoe**, daughter of Pistis Sophia, rebukes the arrogant ruler. In the revelation, **Sabaoth**, one of the offspring, sees the higher power, rejects his father and matter, praises Sophia and Zoe, and is elevated to authority in the seventh heaven below the veil.

That reversal matters because the story's cosmology is not a simple equation of “lower = evil, higher = good.” A ruler within the lower genealogy can recognise the false totalisation of the parent authority and change relation.

The whole therefore already contains **recognition within structure**, not only escape from structure.

## 2.5 Adam, Eve and the rulers' attempt to possess life

The tractate then retells Genesis through its own Gnostic exegesis. The rulers participate in forming **Adam** after an image they have perceived; the human becomes living through a power they do not finally own. **Eve / the spiritual feminine principle** appears in a field where the rulers repeatedly attempt to dominate, possess and reproduce what exceeds their authority.

The exact variant relations among spiritual Eve, her shadow/counterpart and the rulers require edition-level source control before publication prose. The current whole-recovery point is sufficient: **the rulers can form, name and govern within the lower field, yet life and spiritual origin exceed the jurisdiction they claim.**

## 2.6 Norea · flood · refusal of the rulers

The later human generation brings **Norea** to the centre. The rulers plan a flood; Noah builds the ark. Norea's relation to the ark and flood differs strikingly from the canonical biblical story, and she subsequently confronts the rulers directly.

When the rulers claim authority over her through Eve, Norea refuses the genealogy they impose. She tells them that she is not their descendant and that she comes from the world above. Their claim to rule is therefore contested at the level of **origin**.

The rulers attempt coercion. Norea cries to the higher divine reality for rescue.

## 2.7 Eleleth · rescue · revelation of the root

**Eleleth**, one of the great luminaries / light-givers associated with the invisible Spirit, descends to Norea. His office is twofold:

1. he rescues her from the rulers' immediate claim;
2. he teaches her **about her root** and the rulers' own origin.

The story's return is therefore not merely a stronger ruler defeating weaker rulers. The decisive operation is **genealogical and epistemic disclosure**:

```text
rulers claim authority over Norea
        ↓
Norea refuses the imposed genealogy
        ↓
Eleleth reveals the rulers' own derivative origin
        ↓
their cosmic power is re-situated inside a larger order
        ↓
Norea's root is disclosed as exceeding their universe
```

Authority is limited by recovered provenance.

---

# 3. What whole-story recovery changes

A compressed “archons = bad rulers” reading loses the tractate's central machinery. The whole contains:

- Pistis Sophia's creative initiative;
- veil, shadow and material realm;
- an arrogant ruler mistaking local horizon for total reality;
- subordinate rulers and layered heavens;
- Zoe's rebuke;
- Sabaoth's recognition and changed allegiance;
- human formation inside the rulers' world;
- the rulers' attempts to possess or administer life they did not originate;
- Norea's refusal of their genealogy;
- Eleleth's rescue and disclosure of the root.

The narrative's deepest source-side movement is therefore **false sovereignty corrected by provenance**.

The rulers' mistake is not that their local world is imaginary. They possess real efficacy inside it. Their mistake is to infer from local efficacy and local visibility that their order is self-grounding and exhaustive.

---

# 4. Human-amplified ledger

This whole is newly recovered from source work. Native 020 must therefore distinguish current project relations from candidate amplification.

## 4.1 Layered frame / local-totalisation relation

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** the chief ruler's declaration can strongly **figure** the project's mature Hybris relation: a determinate local formation installs itself at the zero/ground office because it cannot see the conditions outside its frame.

The fit is exact enough to preserve as an amplification prompt, but it has not yet been supplied or ratified by Frank as the author's symbolic appointment to this tractate.

## 4.2 Veil / Māyā comparison

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** the tractate's veil can be compared with the project's Māyā/frame field insofar as both organise a distinction between a locally visible world and conditions not visible within that world.

The doctrines are not identical. The Gnostic lower-world cosmology and the project's positive Śaiva account of Māyā have materially different metaphysical valences; any comparison must preserve that difference.

## 4.3 Archon / technical evaluator comparison

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** an archon may become a useful cross-register image for an evaluator, institution or agent whose real local jurisdiction is silently expanded into ground-authority.

No such technical analogy propagates from this record without human amplification.

## 4.4 Norea / Objective Internality / refusal

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** Norea's refusal of the genealogy assigned by the rulers may eventually compare with Number Six's refusal of exhaustive assigned identity and Daphne's refusal of possessive determination.

The historical, gendered and religious specificity of Norea's scene must remain primary.

---

# 5. Native 020 relation — layered cosmos now has an intact owner

`[[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/NATIVE-020-DEEP-SEAM-RECONCILIATION|Native 020 — Deep-Seam Reconciliation]]` had correctly left the seam blocked until a concrete source whole was named. That blocker is now removed at the **whole-source** level.

The exact current relation is:

```text
Hypostasis source whole
veil · shadow · lower ruler · layered archons · human world · Norea · Eleleth · root
        ↓
possible authored amplification
nested frame / local sovereignty / provenance / return
        ↓
QL / Objective Internality / Hybris / technical governance
only after provenance-preserving comparison
```

The source does **not** prove QL, a modern political theory or an AI architecture. It gives Native 020 an intact cosmological image in which hierarchy, horizon, local power, false totalisation and recovered origin actually occur together.

---

# 6. Source control

**Primary ancient owner:** *The Hypostasis of the Archons* / *The Reality of the Rulers*, Nag Hammadi Codex II,4.

**Current translation carriers used for recovery:**

- Bentley Layton, translation of *The Hypostasis of the Archons* in the Nag Hammadi Library tradition;
- Willis Barnstone / Marvin Meyer, *The Reality of the Rulers* / *The Gnostic Bible* tradition.

**Scholarly control:** Claremont Coptic Encyclopedia's entry on the tractate confirms the veil-divided cosmology and hierarchy of the lower archons; modern close scholarship should be installed in Episteme before publication-level historical claims.

**Still owed:**

- exact Coptic edition / page or line locators;
- source-house records for each quoted or closely paraphrased passage;
- exact variant handling for Eve/spiritual woman/shadow and the anthropogony;
- exact layered-heaven terminology across translations;
- comparative Gnostic cosmology only after this tractate's own whole remains intact.

---

## Return statement

The *Hypostasis of the Archons* is now recoverable as a whole Mytheme because its cosmology is inseparable from its drama of authority. A veil divides realms; shadow becomes the material condition of a lower world; a ruler born inside that world mistakes his horizon for the entirety and generates subordinate rulers; life and human origin repeatedly exceed their claimed jurisdiction; Norea refuses the genealogy through which they would possess her; Eleleth finally reveals both her root and the rulers' derivative origin. **The story's rulers are most dangerous not because they are unreal, but because real local power is mistaken for self-grounding total authority.** That last sentence is presently a system synthesis of the recovered whole and remains `human-amplified: no` until Frank ratifies the amplification.

The 2026 recovery belongs to reception, not the ancient story's timeline. The earlier page arranged the material partly in cosmological order. The developed telling below follows the tractate's disclosure: ruler and human formation; Norea's crisis; Eleleth's retrospective account of origins; promised liberation. The existing cosmological account is retained inside that retrospective speech. The late revelation changes the reader's understanding of the earlier coercion. The [complete Layton translation](https://earlychristianwritings.com/text/archons.html) was read for this development. No canonical II,4 SOURCE or local primary copy was found at dispatch; therefore no sibling NOTES could be opened for that work. Source admission remains with the parent. The earlier page's Barnstone–Meyer carrier is retained as a named translation lead, not represented as independently collated in this pass. The opening invokes apostolic teaching about cosmic powers and answers a correspondent's inquiry. ## #1 — A formed human exceeds the makers ### The arrogant ruler mistakes a local realm for the entirety The tractate begins from the rulers' claim to authority. Their chief is described as **blind**, powerful, ignorant and arrogant. He declares himself to be the sole god. A voice from incorruptibility answers that claim and names his error: he does not see the greater reality whose absence from his field he has mistaken for non-existence. This is a source-side operation before any project amplification: ```text local ruler sees only his own field ↓ field appears without visible superior inside itself ↓ absence from the field is read as absence from reality ↓ local power claims total authority ↓ voice from beyond the field contradicts the claim ``` The chief ruler is named **Samael** in this rebuke; the source tradition also gives the names **Yaldabaoth / Sakla** in the cosmological revelation. ### Adam, Eve and the rulers' attempt to possess life The tractate then retells Genesis through its own Gnostic exegesis. The rulers participate in forming **Adam** after an image they have perceived; the human becomes living through a power they do not finally own. **Eve / the spiritual feminine principle** appears in a field where the rulers repeatedly attempt to dominate, possess and reproduce what exceeds their authority. The spiritual woman, bodily woman, shadow and instructing principle retain distinct narrated offices in the consulted Layton telling. Exact Coptic wording and differences from Barnstone–Meyer still require edition-level source control. The recovered relation remains: **the rulers can form, name and govern within the lower field, yet life and spiritual origin exceed the jurisdiction they claim.** Incorruptibility's reflection attracts the rulers. Adam is their earthen decoy; breath fails to raise him until spirit descends from the Adamantine Land. Animals receive names; the garden brings prohibition. Sleep becomes ignorance. The spiritual woman awakens Adam, escapes pursuit as a tree, and leaves a shadow that the rulers sexually violate. The instructing principle enters and leaves the serpent. Eating exposes spiritual nakedness; fig leaves, blame, curses, expulsion and imposed toil follow. The formation and the pursuit belong together. The rulers' inability to originate the life they seek is followed by an attempt to possess its manifestation. The account's distinction between the woman and the shadow is therefore materially necessary to Norea's later denial of their claimed genealogy. Retaining that distinction tells the scene without making the violated figure disappear from the narrative. Violence remains part of the world administered by the rulers. ## #2 — Norea refuses the ancestry of possession Cain farms; Abel keeps sheep. Rejected and accepted offerings lead to fratricide, accusing blood and sevenfold vengeance. Seth follows Abel; Eve then bears Norea. A ruler warns Noah of the flood. Mount Sir receives the ark; Noah excludes Norea, whose breath burns it. He rebuilds. ### Norea · flood · refusal of the rulers The later human generation brings **Norea** to the centre. The rulers plan a flood; Noah builds the ark. Norea's relation to the ark and flood differs strikingly from the canonical biblical story, and she subsequently confronts the rulers directly. When the rulers claim authority over her through Eve, Norea refuses the genealogy they impose. She tells them that she is not their descendant and that she comes from the world above. Their claim to rule is therefore contested at the level of **origin**. The rulers attempt coercion. Norea cries to the higher divine reality for rescue. ### Eleleth · rescue · revelation of the root **Eleleth**, one of the great luminaries / light-givers associated with the invisible Spirit, descends to Norea. His office is twofold: 1. he rescues her from the rulers' immediate claim; 2. he teaches her **about her root** and the rulers' own origin. The story's return is therefore not merely a stronger ruler defeating weaker rulers. The decisive operation is **genealogical and epistemic disclosure**: ```text rulers claim authority over Norea ↓ Norea refuses the imposed genealogy ↓ Eleleth reveals the rulers' own derivative origin ↓ their cosmic power is re-situated inside a larger order ↓ Norea's root is disclosed as exceeding their universe ``` Authority is limited by recovered provenance. Norea describes Eleleth's golden appearance and snowy clothing. Norea's question to the arriving angel preserves her active part in the encounter. Rescue does not end her inquiry. She asks about the authorities' genesis, material and force; the account that follows answers the exact power that threatened her. The movement therefore changes the position from which the rulers can be understood. They had presumed to tell Norea where she came from. She receives an account of where they came from. ## #3 — The rescuing speech turns back to the rulers' beginning ### Pistis Sophia · veil · shadow · matter · lower ruler Later, through **Eleleth's revelation to Norea**, the tractate gives the rulers' genesis. **Pistis Sophia** desires to create without her consort. A veil lies between the world above and the lower realms. **Shadow** comes into being beneath the veil and becomes **matter**. A deficient/arrogant lion-like ruler emerges in that lower condition. The ruler opens his eyes upon an apparently limitless quantity of matter and repeats the same totalising claim: because his horizon contains no visible prior reality, he treats his local horizon as the whole. Sophia introduces light into matter, exposing the ruler's mistake without making the lower realm unreal. The source whole therefore differentiates: ```text incorruptible / invisible above ↓ boundary veil ↓ shadow ↓ matter / lower realm ↓ local ruler arises within that realm ↓ local ruler mistakes his horizon for the entirety ↓ light from above reveals the error ``` ### The rulers and their layered heavens The lower ruler generates **seven offspring**, rulers like their parent. The cosmology then distributes rule through layered heavens / chaotic realms. A secondary scholarly summary of the tractate describes Yaldabaoth's offspring as an organised hierarchy corresponding to the higher realm; surviving translations also place Sabaoth in the seventh heaven beneath the veil and describe the heavens of chaos becoming populated by subordinate powers. This is the actual source-side basis of Native 020's **layered cosmos / firmament / archons** seam. The important relation is not simply “seven levels.” It is: ```text higher order ↓ reflected / imitated through lower formation lower ruler ↓ subordinate rulers / heavens ↓ administered cosmos ↓ local beings inhabit a world whose rulers claim more authority than their own genesis warrants ``` The hierarchy is therefore simultaneously cosmological and political within the story. ### Zoe · Sabaoth · repentance inside the hierarchy The lower hierarchy is not absolutely homogeneous. **Zoe**, daughter of Pistis Sophia, rebukes the arrogant ruler. In the revelation, **Sabaoth**, one of the offspring, sees the higher power, rejects his father and matter, praises Sophia and Zoe, and is elevated to authority in the seventh heaven below the veil. That reversal matters because the story's cosmology is not a simple equation of “lower = evil, higher = good.” A ruler within the lower genealogy can recognise the false totalisation of the parent authority and change relation. The whole therefore already contains **recognition within structure**, not only escape from structure. Zoe's breath becomes a fiery angel, binding Yaldabaoth in Tartaros. Sabaoth's throne has a four-faced cherubic chariot, ministers, harps and lyres; Zoe teaches at his right, wrath stands left. Yaldabaoth's envy generates death and death's offspring. The two rebellions retain different offices. Sabaoth changes allegiance within the rulers' genealogy; Norea denies that their genealogy contains her root. Their relation cannot be compressed into one hero escaping one parent. The elevation of Sabaoth changes the lower administration, whereas the disclosure to Norea addresses the jurisdiction that administration can claim over her. Sophia's initiative, Zoe's intervention and Eleleth's teaching are likewise distinct acts. Calling all three “wisdom” would conceal who generates, who acts against the ruler, and who makes origins known. ## #4 — The root disclosed and the ending still to come His revelation promises disclosure after three generations. Eleleth's answer extends to Norea's offspring and to future deliverance. The true Man will bring saving disclosure; spiritual beings will be freed, and the authorities' world will lose its dominion. The closing hymn gives the ending a collective voice before Father, Son and Holy Spirit. This prospective ending matters: Norea's immediate rescue is not narrated as the completion of the whole cosmic history. Robinson's [account of the tractate's ending](https://ccdl.claremont.edu/digital/api/collection/cce/id/1001/download) **sources** this bounded synopsis; the complete Layton telling retains the future teaching, anointing, ascent, lament and praise in their sequence. ### What whole-story recovery changes A compressed “archons = bad rulers” reading loses the tractate's central machinery. The whole contains: - Pistis Sophia's creative initiative; - veil, shadow and material realm; - an arrogant ruler mistaking local horizon for total reality; - subordinate rulers and layered heavens; - Zoe's rebuke; - Sabaoth's recognition and changed allegiance; - human formation inside the rulers' world; - the rulers' attempts to possess or administer life they did not originate; - Norea's refusal of their genealogy; - Eleleth's rescue and disclosure of the root. The narrative's deepest source-side movement is therefore **false sovereignty corrected by provenance**. The rulers' mistake is not that their local world is imaginary. They possess real efficacy inside it. Their mistake is to infer from local efficacy and local visibility that their order is self-grounding and exhaustive. ### Shared archetypal relation, situated telling [Neumann's shared whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **compares** genesis, separation, contested parental authority and the emergence of a being able to answer its inherited world. The shared archetypal structuration is already the project's appointed ground. **human-amplified: no** for equating this tractate's figures or episodes one-to-one with Neumann's stages. This local comparison remains a proposal: Norea's resistance can enter the shared question of liberation without being renamed as Neumann's hero, and her revealed origin need not become a psychological episode of ego formation. The difference is consequential. The existing Neumann whole moves through separation toward renewed differentiated participation. This tractate gives the realms a pronounced opposition and directs its promised ending beyond the rulers' order. Sabaoth's internal reversal and Norea's transcendent root keep that opposition complex, but they do not make its soteriology identical to the positive Śaiva account of manifestation. The comparison must return to the whole that resists its simplification. The authorial native field and its complete eightfold remain as recovered in the preceding work; no local god or episode replaces a determination. Taylor's `X/x` remains native. [Homology and Analogy](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this proposed crossing at evidence register 3: identify the shared operation and the consequence that survives, while retaining the source's theological difference. **human-amplified: no** for a settled QL appointment to this story. This whole also remains distinct from [the Valentinian Sophia–Horos–Achamoth whole](../valentinian-sophia-horos-achamoth/WHOLE.md), which **compares** a separate source tradition. That companion cannot fill a gap in II,4. Norea, Eleleth, Zoe and Sabaoth keep their present offices; Horos and Achamoth are not inserted into them. No historical identity or line of transmission between the two wholes is asserted by the shared Sophia name. ## #5→0 — Return with the whole and its source seam intact ### Human-amplified ledger This whole is newly recovered from source work. Native 020 must therefore distinguish current project relations from candidate amplification. ### Layered frame / local-totalisation relation **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** the chief ruler's declaration can strongly **figure** the project's mature Hybris relation: a determinate local formation installs itself at the zero/ground office because it cannot see the conditions outside its frame. The fit is exact enough to preserve as an amplification prompt, but it has not yet been supplied or ratified by Frank as the author's symbolic appointment to this tractate. ### Veil / Māyā comparison **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** the tractate's veil can be compared with the project's Māyā/frame field insofar as both organise a distinction between a locally visible world and conditions not visible within that world. The doctrines are not identical. The Gnostic lower-world cosmology and the project's positive Śaiva account of Māyā have materially different metaphysical valences; any comparison must preserve that difference. ### Archon / technical evaluator comparison **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** an archon may become a useful cross-register image for an evaluator, institution or agent whose real local jurisdiction is silently expanded into ground-authority. No such technical analogy propagates from this record without human amplification. ### Norea / Objective Internality / refusal **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** Norea's refusal of the genealogy assigned by the rulers may eventually compare with Number Six's refusal of exhaustive assigned identity and Daphne's refusal of possessive determination. The historical, gendered and religious specificity of Norea's scene must remain primary. ### Native 020 relation — layered cosmos now has an intact owner `[[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/NATIVE-020-DEEP-SEAM-RECONCILIATION|Native 020 — Deep-Seam Reconciliation]]` had correctly left the seam blocked until a concrete source whole was named. That blocker is now removed at the **whole-source** level. The exact current relation is: ```text Hypostasis source whole veil · shadow · lower ruler · layered archons · human world · Norea · Eleleth · root ↓ possible authored amplification nested frame / local sovereignty / provenance / return ↓ QL / Objective Internality / Hybris / technical governance only after provenance-preserving comparison ``` The source does **not** prove QL, a modern political theory or an AI architecture. It gives Native 020 an intact cosmological image in which hierarchy, horizon, local power, false totalisation and recovered origin actually occur together. The coverage row names [A20 — Image, Valuation, Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) as the intended return: this whole **returns-to** its question of image and claimed authority through the intact coercion/refusal/revelation movement. This is an outgoing retrieval route, **human-amplified: no** for the unratified technical or psychological interpretation. It does not certify a reciprocal consumer edit or override the four inherited candidate flags above. ### Source control — current recovery **Primary ancient owner:** Nag Hammadi Codex II,4, *The Hypostasis of the Archons* / *The Reality of the Rulers*. **Source relation:** Paraphrased. The named ancient actors and events belong to the telling; local symbolic comparisons remain Offered, with relation-local human-amplification flags. Neither pending source admission nor quotation readiness lowers an independently Derived or Argued native operation. **Read this pass:** the complete Bentley Layton online translation at Early Christian Writings, whose footer identifies its origin in the Gnostic Society Library and *The Nag Hammadi Library in English* edited by James M. Robinson; Stephen E. Robinson's complete Coptic Encyclopedia entry, CE 1261a–1262a. The latter is scholarly control, not a substitute for the primary telling. Its compressed Eve/serpent account is not used to overwrite the more differentiated Layton sequence. **Translation seam:** the Barnstone–Meyer original hosting could not be retrieved successfully in this pass. A Korean repost was encountered but was not accepted as an English translation-control witness. The earlier recovery's named carrier remains a lead. Exact Coptic text/edition, page-line references, damaged passages and translation differences remain pending. No quoted modern translation passage is reproduced here as quotation-ready. **Parent foldback:** install or resolve the II,4 primary house, record the selected online translation and complete-reading scope, and admit independently scoped passage records for human formation and the spiritual-woman/shadow distinction; family/flood/Norea; Eleleth's cosmogony and Sabaoth; and the promised ending. Keep the scholarly commentary separate from the primary translation, and collate Barnstone–Meyer before any variant claim. There were no source or consumer writes in this development. ### Return statement The *Hypostasis of the Archons* is now recoverable as a whole Mytheme because its cosmology is inseparable from its drama of authority. A veil divides realms; shadow becomes the material condition of a lower world; a ruler born inside that world mistakes his horizon for the entirety and generates subordinate rulers; life and human origin repeatedly exceed their claimed jurisdiction; Norea refuses the genealogy through which they would possess her; Eleleth finally reveals both her root and the rulers' derivative origin. **The story's rulers are most dangerous not because they are unreal, but because real local power is mistaken for self-grounding total authority.** That last sentence is presently a system synthesis of the recovered whole and remains `human-amplified: no` until Frank ratifies the amplification.
